text:
morgan: CI red on main — a bunch of kafka integration tests failing across matrix. anyone seeing this?
ci-bot: build #8423 failed: ci/integration (kafka-tests) — https://ci.redwood/8423 
sam: throwing logs here, looks like the proxy can't be resolved
morgan: ```
ERROR: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = dial tcp: lookup kafka-proxy.default.svc.cluster.local: no such host
  at github.com/redwood/inference/pkg/kafka.(*Client).Dial
  at github.com/redwood/inference/tests/integration.TestEndToEnd
```
alex: that lookup failing smells like a DNS blip for the mock-kafka proxy in the k8s test cluster (kube-dns/coredns hiccup)
jess: can we bisect to the first failing commit? or is this infra-related (flaky DNS) and not code?
sam: quick check — I pulled the earlier runs: last green on that suite was run 1933331801, first failing observed at 1933333002. multiple jobs show the same host lookup error.
infra-bot: note — we had a short maintenance window earlier, rolling kube-dns restart in staging at 1933334488.
shreyas: temporary workaround: set KAFKA_PROXY_HOST to mock-kafka-svc.internal in the CI env for the job and rerun. command: `/rerun ci/integration kafka-tests --env KAFKA_PROXY_HOST=mock-kafka-svc.internal`
morgan: doing the rerun with the override now
ci-bot: rerun queued: build #8424 (ci/integration — kafka-tests)
alex: if #8424 passes, we should mark the affected tests as flaky and open an infra ticket to pin the mock-kafka chart/version. pinging @eng-infra :point_up:
jess: agreed — I'll open a ticket and add a flaky marker for `kafka_consumer_end_to_end.test_conn_reset` and `kafka_producer_integration.test_large_messages` :thumbsup:
infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-587: pin mock-kafka chart + investigate DNS instability in CI clusters — assigned to @shreyas
morgan: thanks. if rerun still fails we'll disable the kafka suite in the nightly job until infra can stabilize or we have a better mock fallback.
shreyas: I'll look into the DNS logs and see if we have metrics around resolution latency; also will try to pin the chart in a staging replacement today.
alex: heads-up for release: if this persists, it could block our PR gating. keep the updates here and @eng-oncall if it needs escalation.
morgan: noted — will update thread. thx all :heart:
